name: paired-topology-followup-v1
checkpoint_selection: minimum validation cross entropy; first minimum wins
primary_endpoint: test accuracy difference, balanced minus random, paired by seed
inference: two-sided Monte Carlo paired sign-flip test, 200000 draws, add-one p; Holm correction across four primary hypotheses; paired-seed percentile bootstrap with 20000 draws for descriptive 95% intervals
limits: Settings frozen locally before training. These datasets and original test results were inspected previously. New training/split seeds provide a within-benchmark follow-up, not a new external dataset, independent preregistration, universal topology advantage, or robot-learning result. Timings under concurrent local workloads are descriptive, not hardware benchmarks.
